en: Colorized aerial view of a large institutional complex set amid trees and surrounded by scattered houses and fields. The foreground shows multi‑storey classical buildings with green roofs and a central pedimented façade, likely official or military buildings. In the middle distance is a large rectangular parade ground enclosed by long barracks‑like structures. The landscape behind stretches into gently rolling countryside under a blue sky with a few clouds. Red printed captions in German appear at the top left and top right of the image.
